title: Coalition transport preserves membership
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with equal cardinality, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The image of $i$ under the coalition transport permutation belongs to $B$ if and only if $i$ belongs to $A$.
